title: InputLambdaProcessorUpdate

allOf.description:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the new Amazon Lambda function that is used to preprocess the records in the stream.

To specify an earlier version of the Lambda function than the latest, include the Lambda function version in the Lambda function ARN. For more information about Lambda ARNs, see Example ARNs: Amazon Lambda

description: For a SQL-based Kinesis Data Analytics application, represents an update to the InputLambdaProcessor that is used to preprocess the records in the stream.
